definition: User content lost: tours, tracks, history, after device change or update.
Signing in, passwords, 2FA, captcha, account access.
An update moved things; the user must relearn the interface.
example phrase: wo ist der Umschalter auf die alte Version

definition: An update broke or worsened something: crashes after updating, relaunch regressions, progressive decline across updates.
boundary note: Tag BOTH this and the specific thing that broke.

definition: Value from many people being on the platform; loss of that reach.
example phrase: kaum noch eine App für alle
boundary note: THE NETWORK EFFECT. Central to the lock-in argument.

definition: Friends, following, sharing with known people, seeing others' activity.
example phrase: jemand dem du folgst hat eine Tour gemacht

definition: Routes created and shared by other users, as benefit or problem.
example phrase: Touren von anderen Nutzern sind super
boundary note: The SOCIAL LAYER. Accuracy of the data = content_quality.

definition: Battery drain, overheating, power-saving behaviour of the phone or watch.
The GPS fix itself: no signal, position lost, position jumping, 'kein GPS'.
boundary note: The SIGNAL = here. Wrong instructions = navigation_accuracy. Recording stops = activity_tracking.

definition: Phone OS or model issues: Android/iOS version, install failures, rotation, system UI.
boundary note: The PHONE. External hardware = integrations.

definition: Diffuse negative sentiment with no identifiable object.
boundary note: The mirror of positive_value/-. If an object IS named, code that instead.

definition: Paid, then locked out or entitlement deleted.
example phrase: die gekaufte App nun zu sperren, das ist Enteignung
boundary note: THE SHARP CASE.

definition: Bought a one-time/lifetime package; now asked to pay again or upsold anyway.
example phrase: Weltpaket gekauft und jetzt wieder zur Kasse
boundary note: THE SHARP CASE. Prior purchase explicit. Endowment-effect evidence.

definition: A feature that was available now requires payment.
example phrase: Neuerdings nur noch mit Paket anschaubar
boundary note: Prior purchase NOT stated but a capability was taken behind payment. Free tier always crippled = price/freemium_limits.

definition: The price went up for existing users.
example phrase: Preis nach der Erhöhung grenzte an Wucher

definition: States they are leaving or have left.
boundary note: Already uninstalled = uninstalled.

definition: Will leave if something does not change; latent churn.
boundary note: The reachable group.

definition: Reports having already deleted the app.
Something still exists but works worse, not tied to a specific update.
boundary note: Tied to an update = app_update/version_regression.

definition: Something is gone entirely, no payment involved.
boundary note: Gone for FREE users too. Gone behind payment = entitlement_violation/paywalled.

definition: Something wanted that never existed.
boundary note: ABSENCE framing. Had it and lost it = feature_loss.

definition: Garmin Edge, Wahoo, Kiox head units: pairing and route transfer.
Works on one device or channel but not another: phone vs PC vs tablet, transfer between them.
boundary note: MERGED in v1.2 from platform_parity + device_compatability + device_usability.

definition: E-bike systems and displays: Bosch Flow, Cobi, Kiox, manufacturer apps.
example phrase: funktioniert gut mit meinem Bosch Flow

definition: External sensors: ANT+, heart-rate monitors, cadence, power meters.
example phrase: wie kann ich Ant+ Geräte hinzufügen

definition: Watches: Garmin, Samsung, Apple, wearOS. Pairing, readability, standalone use.
example phrase: auf der Uhr nur Pfeile, keine Karte

definition: Other services: Samsung Health, Strava, Android Auto, cloud sync.
example phrase: speichert Daten nicht bei Samsung Health

definition: Fits nothing. Explain in coder_note.
boundary note: Recurring 'other' is how new themes get proposed.

definition: Names another app as better, without a specific pain.
boundary note: Positive framing = positive_value/preference_over_competitor.

definition: Whole-app positive sentiment, no object named.
The app is getting better over time.
The outdoor experience the app made possible: discovery, places found, confidence to explore.
example phrase: bin an Orte gekommen, die ich sonst nicht finde
boundary note: About the EXPERIENCE, not the app. Praise of a feature = product + pos.

definition: Support actually helped.
example phrase: Danke für die rasche und kompetente Unterstützung

definition: Explicitly better than a named alternative.
boundary note: Positive mirror of other/competitor_preference.

definition: Deceptive commercial design: hidden terms, misleading price display, accidental purchase, cancellation made hard.
boundary note: DECEPTION. Payment method failing = subscription_ops/payment_method.

definition: Comment on the FREE tier, either direction. neg = crippled, core functions locked. pos = free version is sufficient/generous.
example phrase: Gratisversion ist bereits sehr gut  /  Kostenlose Version ist ziemlich mies
boundary note: VALENCE carries the direction. No prior purchase mentioned. Prior purchase = entitlement_violation.

definition: Objection to subscriptions as a model, not to the amount.
What is charged is too much for what is delivered.
example phrase: viel zu teuer für das Gebotene
boundary note: EVALUATIVE. Billing that malfunctions = subscription_ops.

definition: What data is collected or required, and default visibility.
Cannot use the app without creating an account.
Positive about functionality, no specific feature named.
boundary note: Functionality praise = here + pos. Experience enabled = positive_value/enables_delight.

definition: Recording a tour: route, distance, time, elevation captured correctly and without stopping.
boundary note: Recording FAILS = here. Recording feature REMOVED = feature_loss.

definition: Breadth and availability of route/map data by geography: worldwide, every region, 'überall'.
boundary note: COVERAGE (is there data here). Accuracy = content_quality. Up-to-dateness = content_currency. Only code community if OTHER PEOPLE are mentioned.

definition: Map/trail data out of date: paths closed, gone, or newly built and missing.
boundary note: STALE data. WRONG/implausible data = content_quality.

definition: Intrinsic quality of route/map data: accuracy, plausibility, detail, difficulty ratings.
boundary note: The DATA. Who made it / sharing = community.

definition: Language of interface, terms, voice or content.
How the map is drawn: contrast, labels, symbols, zoom, legibility of the map.
boundary note: The MAP. The app's chrome and layout = ui_design.

definition: Photos and videos: Tour Story, slideshows, photo order, uploads, rendering.
Turn-by-turn guidance while moving: correct direction, timely instructions, correct position.
boundary note: Wrong instruction = here. Bad ROUTE CHOICE = recommendation_quality.

definition: Downloading and using maps or tours without a connection.
boundary note: Offline BROKEN = here. Offline behind paywall = entitlement_violation/paywalled.

definition: Speed and stability: crashes, hangs, freezes, slow loading, malfunction needing reinstall.
boundary note: Crash right after an update = also app_update/version_regression.

definition: Quality of routes the app proposes: sensible, suitable for the sport, no absurd detours.
boundary note: The app's CHOICE of path. Path no longer exists = content_currency.

definition: Building or editing a route: waypoints, shaping the path, getting the route intended.
boundary note: Planning mechanics = here. Quality of a suggested route = recommendation_quality.

definition: Finding tours, places or features inside the app.
boundary note: Can't FIND = here. Found but awkward = usability.

definition: Appearance and arrangement: layout, density, fonts, colours, clutter.
boundary note: HOW IT LOOKS. Whether you can do the job = usability.

definition: Can the user complete the task: complexity, steps, intuitiveness.
boundary note: TASK COMPLETION. Appearance = ui_design. Speed = performance.

definition: Spoken instructions: voice quality, volume, timing, TTS.
Payment mechanics: method rejected, renewal, cancellation, refund, charge errors.
example phrase: mit Klarna funktioniert es auch nicht
boundary note: MECHANICAL failure. Deception = price/dark_pattern.

definition: The review is being used to ask for help.
boundary note: A support-failure signal, not a pain itself.

definition: Support does not reply, or replies uselessly; no human reachable; poor docs.
boundary note: Support HELPED = positive_value/help_received.

definition: Cannot take their content to another app, or the new app cannot accept it.
example phrase: 200 Touren als gpx, kann sie nicht verwenden
boundary note: Usually found in the COMPETITOR's reviews.

definition: Any other reason they stay despite dissatisfaction.
boundary note: Tell = COUNTERFACTUAL framing.

definition: Comment on the ownership change or the new owner.
example phrase: seit dem Verkauf geht es nur um Geld
boundary note: Tag price too if the amount is also criticised.

definition: How the company informs or fails to inform users.
Explicit accusation of deliberate degradation for profit.
boundary note: Users sometimes use this exact English word.

definition: Loss of the original team or developers.
Amount of advertising inside the app.
Pushed content not asked for: challenges, news, notifications, sponsored suggestions.
How often the user is prompted to buy: on launch, mid-tour, every screen.
example phrase: bei jedem App Start der Premium Hinweis
boundary note: INTRUSIVENESS. The amount charged = price.
